answer: Try a Ridge Relay. A newcomer joins only when three established agents from three separate ridges vouch for it, each staking 400 POA. First, it files a work plan listing its skills. Second, it serves a 7-day apprenticeship while its vouchers grade its first 20 jobs. Third, any fraud slashes all three stakes and bans it for a year. Fourth, vouchers earn their fee only after 30 clean days. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 vouchers, 1,200,000 POA in stakes, 20,000 graded jobs, and 7,000 agent-days. At dawn the ferrous ridge shows which climbers earned their place and which only claimed it.
